def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    # Continue the sequence of marked points along its linear progression, in color 2.
    dr = pts[-1][0] - pts[-2][0]
    dc = pts[-1][1] - pts[-2][1]
    r,c = pts[-1]
    while 0 <= r+dr < len(out) and 0 <= c+dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr; c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
